notes.text: The accessible gaonic commentary reports as an alternative that Rabbi Yoḥanan had a surviving son named Mattanah and sent him to study with Shemuel in Babylonia. Ben Yehoyada reports the same tradition via Yuḥasin.
The context and cited gaonic tradition identify the two pronouns and the sense of surviving.
